name: Pixies
hook: A Boston band whose quiet verses and screaming choruses Kurt Cobain said he was trying to copy on 'Smells Like Teen Spirit'.
blurb: Pixies formed in Boston in 1986: Black Francis, Joey Santiago, Kim Deal and David Lovering. Their songs often went quiet in the verses and suddenly very loud in the choruses, with Black Francis switching from a mutter to a scream. Their first full album, 'Surfer Rosa', was recorded by Steve Albini at Q Division in Boston in November and December 1987 and released by the British label 4AD in March 1988. Kurt Cobain of Nirvana said that 'Smells Like Teen Spirit' was him trying to rip off Pixies, and the soft-loud pattern is the specific thing he named as borrowed. He hired Albini to record Nirvana because of 'Surfer Rosa'. Pixies split in 1993 and reunited in 2004.
